Package model

Class SistemaArchivos

java.lang.Object
model.SistemaArchivos
public class SistemaArchivos extends Object
Implements the simplified block-based file system used by the menu service.

This model demonstrates the essential structures of a file system in a compact way: a SuperBloque, an inode table, a bitmap of occupied blocks, and an array of data blocks. Files are stored by assigning one or more blocks and recording those block indexes inside an Inodo.

The class also provides adapter-style methods used by service classes that expect path-based operations. Since this simplified version does not support real directories, path inputs are reduced to file names when possible.

User-created files are persisted in archivos_guardados.txt. The file is loaded during initialization and rewritten after successful create, update, or delete operations so the simulator can preserve data between executions.

  • Method Details

    • inicializar

      public void inicializar()
      Initializes the simulated file system and loads persisted files.

      Existing in-memory allocation data is reset before loading persisted files. This makes initialization deterministic and ensures that saved content becomes the starting state for the new execution.

    • estaInicializado

      public boolean estaInicializado()
      Indicates whether the file system has already been initialized.
      Returns:
      true if initialized; false otherwise

    • crearArchivo

      public String crearArchivo(String nombreArchivo, String contenido)
      Creates a new file and stores its content across available blocks.

      The creation process validates the file name, checks for duplicates, reserves an inode, calculates required block capacity, writes the content fragments into available blocks, and persists the updated file list.

      Parameters:
      nombreArchivo - the file name to create; spaces and path separators are not accepted
      contenido - the text content to store; null is treated as an empty string
      Returns:
      a status message describing the result

    • escribirArchivo

      public boolean escribirArchivo(String ruta, String contenido, boolean append)
      Writes content to an existing file.

      The simplified model updates a file by reading the current content, deleting the old allocation, and creating a new allocation with the final content. This keeps block assignment consistent with the current content size.

      Parameters:
      ruta - the file path or file name
      contenido - the content to write
      append - true to append; false to overwrite
      Returns:
      true if the file was updated successfully
